cases.sentence: Я вновь поднял глаза и вижу: предо мной четыре колесницы, выезжающие из ущелья между двумя ___.
cases.explain: «медными горами» — after the preposition «между», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Again I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, four chariots came out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of bronze.

cases.sentence: Тот, у которого вороные кони, направляется в северный край, тот, у которого ___, — на запад , а тот, у которого пегие, — на юг.
cases.explain: «белые кони» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The one with the black horses goes out toward the north country; and the white went out after them; and the dappled went out toward the south country.”

cases.sentence: ___ вышли, и им не терпелось пройти по земле дозором.
cases.explain: «Сильные кони» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The strong went out, and sought to go that they might walk back and forth through the earth: and he said, “Go around and through the earth!” So they walked back and forth through the earth.

cases.sentence: А венец будет вверен заботам Хелдая , Товии, Иедая и Иосии , сына Софонии, как ___ в храме Господа.
cases.explain: «памятный знак» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in Yahweh’s temple.
